copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp 云 API 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 WhatsApp 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add WhatsApp messaging to your application

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 新增 WhatsApp 官方云 API 通道：复制并注册适配器、安装固定版本依赖、把凭证写入 .env，并在 3000 端口启动 webhook 服务；之后可经 WhatsApp 与机器人 1:1 对话。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 WhatsApp 通道”或“接入 WhatsApp 云 API”，或在 /setup 流程中要配置 WhatsApp 时。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 云 API。
say.note: 会复制并注册 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp 通道，然后运行 /manage-channels 接线。
say.note: 把通道分配给一个代理组。

howto.what_en: Adds the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs the pinned dependency, writes credentials to .env, and starts a webhook server on port 3000 so you can chat 1:1 via WhatsApp.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add a WhatsApp channel" or "connect the WhatsApp Cloud API", or when you need to configure WhatsApp during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Cloud API.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the WhatsApp Cloud adapter.

say_en.text: Set up a WhatsApp webhook at https://example.com/webhook/whatsapp-cloud.
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials and sets that as the callback.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel, then run /manage-channels to wire it.
say_en.note: Assigns the channel to an agent group.
